clove.definition:
n. aromatic flower bud of a clove tree; yields a spice
n. moderate sized very symmetrical red-flowered evergreen widely cultivated in the tropics for its flower buds which are source of cloves
n. one of the small bulblets that can be split off of the axis of a larger garlic bulb
n. spice from dried unopened flower bud of the clove tree; used whole or ground
clove.translation:
n. 丁香
cleave的过去式

clove hitch.translation: n. 卷结, 酒瓶结（一种结绳法）

clove oil.translation:
[化] 丁子香油
[医] 丁香油

cloven hoof.translation: n. 偶蹄, 撒旦或邪恶的象征

cloven-footed.definition: a of or relating to the cloven feet of ruminants or swine
cloven-footed.translation: a. 分趾蹄的, 偶蹄的,似撒旦般穷凶极恶的

cloven-hoofed.definition: a of or relating to the cloven feet of ruminants or swine
cloven-hoofed.translation: a. 偶蹄的, 魔鬼的

clover.definition: n. a plant of the genus Trifolium
clover.translation:
n. 红花草
[建] 三叶草

clover's apparatus.translation: [医] 克洛佛氏器(醚或氯仿麻醉时用)

clover-disease.translation: [医] 香草木樨中毒, 三叶草病(牲畜)

cloverdale.translation: [人名] 克洛弗代尔; [地名] [加拿大、美国] 克洛弗代尔

cloverleaf.definition: n. an interchange that does not require left-hand turns
cloverleaf.translation: n. 四叶苜蓿形的立体道路交叉点

cloverleafs.translation: n. （道路的）苜蓿叶式立体交叉，四叶式立体交叉( cloverleaf的名词复数 )

clovers.definition: n. a plant of the genus Trifolium
clovers.translation: n. 三叶草( clover的复数形式 ); <非正>生活舒适而富裕; 养尊处优; 生活优裕

cloves.definition:
n aromatic flower bud of a clove tree; yields a spice

clovis.definition: n. king of the Franks who unified Gaul and established his capital at Paris and founded the Frankish monarchy; his name was rendered as Gallic `Louis' (466-511)
clovis.translation: n. 克罗维斯；克洛维斯；克洛维（法国国王）

clovis culture.translation: [网络] 克洛维斯文化；克洛维斯文明；克劳维斯文化
